versions.changelog:
- Initial release of convert2docx (v1.0.0): Convert Markdown, plain text, HTML, RTF, LaTeX, reStructuredText, and Org-mode files to .docx using a user-supplied reference.docx style template.
- Supports single file, batch, and drag-and-drop operations on Windows.
- Requires user to specify reference.docx and pandoc.exe paths on first run (saved to config.ini).
- No default template provided; user must prepare their own reference.docx.
- Includes PowerShell and batch script for conversion, with extensive error handling for common pitfalls.
- Output files never overwrite originals and existing target files are skipped automatically.
